definitions.gloss: a person who plots a crime together with others
definitions.explanation: Someone who joins with others in secretly planning a crime or wrongdoing. A formal, legal term.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}は{共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: The police are searching for the co-conspirators.

examples.japanese: かれは{事件|じけん}の{共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}とされた。
examples.english: He was named a co-conspirator in the incident.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{調|しら}べで、ほかに{二人|ふたり}の{共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}がいたことが{分|わ}かった。
examples.english: The investigation revealed that there were two other co-conspirators.

notes:
Composed of {共謀|きょうぼう} (conspiring together) + {者|しゃ} (person). A formal, legal term for someone who takes part in planning a crime with others.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事件|じけん}の{共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}: a co-conspirator in a case
- {共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}を{特定|とくてい}する: to identify the co-conspirators

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {共犯者|きょうはんしゃ}: accomplice — one who takes part in committing the crime, not only in planning it
- {主犯|しゅはん}: principal offender — the leader who plays the central role in a crime
